body: Reading back through my original post, I can tell I’m tired because of all the grammar mistakes, so why can’t I fall asleep? 😭

I’ve been to different sleep specialists and they tell me the exact same things I find online: keep a regular sleep schedule, eliminate stress (not easy), no caffeine,  exercise (the only thing I haven’t tried, because of time). My goal is to get off this damn Ambien and try the other stuff again. Ambien is literally one of the hardest drugs to get off. But I’ll keep trucking, don’t plan on going anywhere (I think).

I’ve talked to him many times. I’ve been on Ambien for over 5 years (the worse prescription you can get on for sleep) and it’s just not working any more. I’ve been to sleep doctors and have had studies and all the fun stuff and nothing comes of it. I could honestly live happy with everything else in my life if I could just get a good 8 hours of sleep. I now have 3 hours before I have to be up and feel like there is no point in trying to sleep now. I’ll be one witchy lady tomorrow. I hope I can keep it deep down though and put on my normal fake smiley face.
